issues: The source asserts lawful versus unlawful modes of gaining wealth from natal planetary status; this is not evidence of real human ethics, crimes or innocence and must never be used as a person-level accusation.
Naturally benefic/malefic planetary labels are modified by sign dignity, aspects, combustion and retrograde motion; these cannot be simplified into inherent human moral character.
Lilly's 'mixing according to discretion' and majority-of-testimonies rules lack frozen weights, tie handling, probability estimates, or a registered rejection criterion.
Direct or lawful and indirect or unlawful methods are explicitly allowed to coexist in the same natal case; a forced single legal outcome would misrepresent this source.
The phrase 'lawful versus unlawfull means' reflects early modern historical wording, not present-day criminal legislation or standards of proof.
The worked Jupiter–Saturn case is hypothetical in the original and is not an independently verified case of theft or misconduct by relatives, servants or livestock traders.
The phrase about the father's kindred, servants and small cattle is period house/planet taxonomy; no evidence about an actual absent family member is supplied.
Direction to terms, square/opposition, converse/direct Fortune, Ascendant direction and revolution are alternative flexible event-time methods; any future test must fix them before results.
The accepted time may be 'or near' the directional contact, with no specific tolerance; retrospective window choice would permit severe overfitting.
Astrological Part of Fortune formula, house system, Saturn aspects, combustion and retrograde astronomy require reproducible calculation with documented exact source conventions.
Benefic/malefic planets in contrary dignities and their combustion or retrogradation produce layered override rules; no original human validation isolates their separate effects.
No independent records of legally proven means, income amounts, property transfers, person-level financial performance or court adjudication were inspected.
The original source is preserved as images and selective clause-level paraphrases; no full diplomatic first-edition transcription or independent paleography is claimed.
PDF594 and PDF595 printed folio561 is a source numbering anomaly, not two copies of the same page or cause to reorder.
The next numbered CHAP CXVII on wealth durability starts in PDF596; its substantive wealth-continuation procedure is outside the current accepted source.
